title: Silent Legacy Local Registry Scout input

registries.title: Registry sources
registries.description: Each entry is a JSON search endpoint for a Secretary of State business registry or municipal permit portal that supports querying by subject name. Since registry APIs differ by state/city, each source declares its own request shape and the JSON path to the result array.

makeWebhookUrl.title: Make.com webhook URL
makeWebhookUrl.description: Destination for new-record payloads. Falls back to the MAKE_WEBHOOK_URL env var.
